topic: Adjusting sample vendors for staging environment
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on adjusting the vendor sample list (specifically changing to include LG Innotek, ID 34) for Germany's staging environment only. The goal is to test this change without affecting production data.

It was clarified that the new sample should only be applied when calculating unique metrics and should not affect general traffic calculations or models. The existing static sample list in the model (`vendor_id in (...)`) remains unchanged for core functions.

Finally, a discrepancy regarding session numbers predicted since June 1, 2023, between production and staging was addressed, confirming that re-aggregating with the new sample starting from this date is acceptable.
decisions: The vendor sample list will be updated to include LG Innotek (ID 34) for Germany's staging environment only.
The change should only affect unique metric calculations and not general traffic modeling.
Re-aggregation of session numbers starting from June 1, 2023, is approved.
action_items: Apply the updated vendor sample list to the staging environment for Germany.
